title: Missing Type-2 Route — RT Mismatch VNI 10011 on dc1-leaf1a
symptom: MAC in VLAN 11 (VNI 10011) locally learned on dc1-leaf1a but not seen on remote VTEPs. EVPN sessions Established.
root_cause: Route-target export for VLAN 11 changed to 10011:99999 on dc1-leaf1a. Remote leaves still import 10011:10011, so they reject dc1-leaf1a Type-2 routes.
fix_command:
router bgp 65101
vlan 11
no route-target both 10011:99999
route-target both 10011:10011
